name: tree-view
title: Tree view
description: A file and folder tree with chevrons that turn, folders that open with an animated height and 1 px indent guides. The selected row sits on a soft pill that slides between rows, rows can carry small badges like M or +2, and the keyboard follows the tree pattern with arrows, Home and End, * and type-ahead.
